purpose: Challenge a finite Campaign122 catalog against the complete frozen historical mechanism frontier and stop rather than re-express, rescue, combine, or field-substitute terminal factors.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_intrabar_body_amount_confirmation_240m
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.concept: Contemporaneous association between absolute own-bar open-close body magnitude and CNY amount.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Campaign024 explicitly rejected body_volume_confirmation because it overlaps terminal range-volume, amount-volatility and up-move-amount mechanisms. Replacing volume with amount or interbar return magnitude with own-bar body is a prohibited field/geometry substitution, not a new channel.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_terminal_bar_range_share_240m
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.concept: Share of full-session log high-low range mass assigned to the 15:00 bar.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Campaign011 explicitly rejected opening_lunch_or_terminal_range_allocation, while Campaign090 and Campaign098 terminally consumed range clock center and variance. Selecting one terminal clock after those results would reopen the terminal range-timing family.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: intraday_return_direction_transition_mutual_information_236p
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.concept: Mutual information between adjacent ternary direction states inside the two trading halves.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Campaign117 rejected transition and conditional-entropy operator choices, Campaign120 terminally consumed the direction-state parser, and Campaign120 prohibited a new alphabet, word length or parser. Mutual information is another exposed transition operator over the same state path.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: holder_count_change_acceleration_2q
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.concept: Difference between the two most recently effective quarterly holder-count change ratios.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Holder-count ratio, absolute change and freshness were already exposed in the legacy finite event library. Adding a second-period differencing operator after those results is a terminal event-factor rescue and introduces cold-start support rather than a new point-in-time source state.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: full_numeric_library_pairwise_interaction_or_model_139f
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.concept: Search selected pairs, nonlinear interactions or a refreshed model over the terminal numeric library.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: Campaign102, Campaign103, Campaign111 and Campaign120 terminally closed refreshed complete-library fitting, subset, pair and model searches after exposure. The historical policy permits only a prospectively frozen finite combination campaign; it does not erase those immutable terminal decisions.

finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.name: top_list_or_high_entitlement_order_flow_source
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.concept: Introduce a richer order-flow or event source requiring unavailable entitlement or an unaccepted historical archive.
finite_prevalue_concept_catalog.reason: The recorded source frontier has only a one-session top_list sample with unresolved duplicates/timing, and the user directed research to continue without 5000-point data. No provider request, entitlement workaround, or proxy reconstruction is allowed.

selection.reason: Every finite proposal is an explicitly rejected variant, a post-exposure operator/combination, or an unaccepted source. Opening values for any of them would increase multiplicity without adding an identified information channel.
